entries.1f15e8842680dbbb: It consists of the real estate leasing business and the building management business. By accumulating a stock of high-quality business-use real estate, it aims to establish an earnings base less affected by market fluctuations, and provides leasing and building management services so that both owners and residents can enjoy satisfaction.

entries.8c3fc2f2ee1dc908: This business is in the “Other” category, which is not included in the reportable segments, and manufactures and wholesales jewelry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥204 million. Kofu Kiho Co., Ltd. is in charge of it.
entries.a08fd28b27702e68: Leveraging the design capabilities developed in its real estate-related business, this business provides beautiful dining spaces where people can feel at ease. Built on healthy, delicious meals and high-quality hospitality, it is advancing plans to open new stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,218 million. The company and ＴＡＫＥＷＡＫＡ Co., Ltd. are in charge of it.
entries.a84da09e9f4bef5a: This business offers high-quality, well-designed women's and men's apparel, and apparel-related goods such as shoes and bags. It leverages the strength of having an integrated structure within the group, spanning product planning, production and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥7,169 million. Flandre Co., Ltd., Tex Tech Co., Ltd. and others are responsible.
entries.c54f233a06b792e1: This is the core of the company group's earnings and a business that supports its stable foundation. It works to raise the added value of its owned properties and secure earnings by acquiring new properties. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥10,010 million. The company, Stardust Co., Ltd., Jugetsu Kosan Co., Ltd. and Murata Shoji Co., Ltd. are in charge of it.
entries.ccc38f0416d054fb: This is an investment business in real estate-related assets such as office buildings and residences. The investment period is generally targeted at 1–5 years; after renovating acquired buildings, it aims to enjoy rental income during the holding period while selling at an appropriate time.
